Where is the outrage over the hundreds of thousands of missing children?

Good news-The Trump administration just found 146,000 kids the last administration lost track of. 

Bad news-Nearly 300,000 are still missing.  Many undoubtedly trafficked.

The fastest way to find them is full-spectrum enforcement, not the current model of targeted enforcement.

Why? Because many sponsors used fake names, fake addresses, and fraudulent documents…

Investigators are wasting time knocking on ghost addresses.

A massive net is the only way to surface these kids quickly. 

Save the children, save the country at the same time. 

Mass deportations are the answer.
